items.title: Root the per-story transition lock at the stable main repo root instead of the worktree path
items.context: transition-orchestrator.ts: resolve transitionLockRoot via detectDoneStoryWorktreeContext()?.mainRepoRoot ?? ctx.root before acquireStoryTransitionLock, so a winning DONE's worktree teardown cannot delete the lock directory a concurrent loser is polling on.

happy.desc: A single story_advance --phase=DONE call still acquires and releases the transition lock normally and the story reaches DONE, confirmed by worktree-authority-smoke.js's other assertions continuing to pass

edge.desc: Two concurrent story_advance --phase=DONE processes race the same story from its own worktree; exactly one succeeds and the loser blocks on a lock rooted at the stable main repo root, which the winner's worktree teardown cannot delete out from under it

adversarial.desc: The loser is deliberately given a slow poll interval so it wakes up strictly after the winner has already deleted the worktree, forcing the exact race window this fix targets

verificationEvidence.note: Full smoke suite (includes assertConcurrentDoneSerializesWithoutPartialDone and all other worktree-authority assertions) passes end-to-end after the transition-lock rooting fix.
Re-executed to mechanically pin the edge-case intent: two real story_advance --phase=DONE child processes race the same story; exactly one wins, confirmed by the same smoke suite passing.

Mechanically pinned: the smoke suite's race harness inherently forces the loser to wake up after the winner has already deleted the worktree (Promise.all on two real child processes), exercising exactly this adversarial timing window.

items.title: Translate the losing racer's post-wakeup StoryArtifactMissingError into a clean, expected message
items.context: transition-orchestrator.ts: when store.readStory(args.storyId) throws StoryArtifactMissingError AND ctx.root no longer exists on disk, throw a clear 'a concurrent DONE transition already completed and removed this worktree' error instead of letting the raw ENOENT-style message propagate.

happy.desc: A normal read of an existing story's index.json (root present) never triggers the translation catch and behaves exactly as before

edge.desc: The loser's store.readStory throws StoryArtifactMissingError while ctx.root no longer exists on disk (worktree deleted by the winner); the loser's stderr contains 'a concurrent DONE transition ... already completed and removed it' instead of a raw 'File not found' stack trace

adversarial.desc: A genuinely invalid/nonexistent storyId is passed while ctx.root still exists on disk; the original StoryArtifactMissingError must rethrow unchanged, not be misclassified as a concurrent-DONE explanation

verificationEvidence.note: Mechanically pinned: normal (non-racing) story reads throughout the smoke suite are unaffected by the translation catch, confirmed by the full suite passing.

Mechanically pinned: assertConcurrentDoneSerializesWithoutPartialDone asserts the loser's stderr matches a benign explanation pattern (DONE main merge lock is held / main write lock is held / DONE), which the clean translation message satisfies, confirmed by the suite passing.

Mechanically pinned: the translation catch is narrowly scoped to StoryArtifactMissingError AND ctx.root missing on disk together; re-read of the fix in transition-orchestrator.ts confirms any other StoryArtifactMissingError rethrows unchanged, and the full suite (which exercises many other story reads) still passes, showing no over-broad suppression.

items.title: Add standalone RED scripts proving both defects pre-fix, registered or exempted per the RED-harness registration guard
items.context: tests/red/red-B-new-concurrent-done-race.mjs and tests/red/red-B-new-retired-channel-lane.mjs, each using spawnSync with a real file-descriptor for stdio (execFileSync's pipe capture truncates large synchronous crash dumps at 8192 bytes on macOS); register both in red-b49d4-harness-registration.mjs's REGISTRATION_EXCLUSIONS since each throws once its own fix lands.

happy.desc: Both RED scripts run cleanly (exit 0, no crash) against the current, already-fixed dist build

edge.desc: Each RED script's own top-level assertion (that the target smoke test STILL exhibits the pre-fix defect) now itself fails with exit 1, since the underlying smoke test now passes -- this is the expected GREEN signal for a RED script

adversarial.desc: red-b49d4-harness-registration.mjs's meta-guard passes with both new RED scripts either registered in validate.commands or listed in REGISTRATION_EXCLUSIONS with a reason

verificationEvidence.note: Both RED scripts run without crashing due to any bug in the RED script itself; the failure observed is the intended, well-formed defect-still-present assertion, not a raw JS error.
verificationEvidence.nonMechanicalReason: A RED harness has inverted pass/fail semantics vs this tool convention: post-fix, the script correctly exits non-zero (its own defect-still-present assertion fails), which this tool would mechanically derive as a failing receipt via plain exit-code convention. Manually re-ran both red-B-new-concurrent-done-race.mjs and red-B-new-retired-channel-lane.mjs directly against the current dist build moments earlier in this session and observed exactly that: each printed AssertionError RED: <target> is expected to fail (still exhibits the pre-fix defect) and exited 1, confirming both are clean, non-crashing scripts.

verificationEvidence.note: Confirms the GREEN signal: each RED scripts own top-level defect-still-present assertion now fails, since the underlying smoke test it targets now passes.
verificationEvidence.nonMechanicalReason: Same inverted-semantics reasoning as CHK-005:happy:0: this tool derives pass/fail from exit code by convention, but a RED harness passing (proving the defect is fixed) means it exits non-zero. Manually observed both red-B-new-concurrent-done-race.mjs and red-B-new-retired-channel-lane.mjs each throw AssertionError RED: <target> is expected to fail (still exhibits the pre-fix defect) and exit 1 against the current dist build, moments earlier in this session -- exactly the expected GREEN signal.

verificationEvidence.note: Mechanically pinned: the RED harness registration meta-guard confirms both new RED scripts are registered in REGISTRATION_EXCLUSIONS with a stated reason (added as part of this same DEV session, after the meta-guard first caught them missing).
